identification: Wide colonial birdseye Huon pine picture frame (well figured, flat ogee profile with gilt slip), outer approx 60 x 50 cm, containing an early 19th-century engraving of gothic abbey ruins (catalogued c.1800) badly water-stained across the upper sheet. The value is in the frame, not the print.
